rules.title: Ronald V. Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords are prohibited from inquiring about, requiring disclosure of, or considering criminal history during advertising, application, tenant selection, or decision-making, and cannot charge higher rent or security deposits based on criminal history.

coverage.summary: Applies to rental housing providers in Berkeley, exempting owner-occupied properties with 1-3 units and specified limited exceptions.
coverage.owner_condition: Owner-occupied properties of 1 to 3 units where an owner of record resides in one unit as their primary residence.

rules.exemptions: Lifetime sex offenders; limited exemptions for public housing/Section 8 properties; owner-occupied 1-3 unit properties; units under agreements allowing owner move-in under BMC 13.76.130 A.9; existing tenants seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates.
rules.quoted_span: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
